en.rc.listen.incorrect: That one sounds like this. Listen again.
en.rc.first.instruction: Listen. Which one starts the same?
en.rc.first.incorrect: That one starts another way. Listen again.
en.rc.first.hint.model: Listen to how each one starts.
en.rc.letters.meet: Look at this letter. This word starts with its sound.
en.rc.letters.picture.instruction: Which one starts with this letter's sound?
en.rc.letters.letter.instruction: Which letter does it start with?
en.rc.letters.picture.correct: Yes. It starts with that sound.
en.rc.letters.letter.correct: Yes. It starts with that letter.
en.rc.blend.instruction: Listen to the slow word. Which one is it?
en.rc.read.instruction: Read the word. Which one is it?
en.rc.blend.incorrect: That is another word. Listen again.
en.rc.rhyme.correct: Yes. They rhyme. They end the same.
en.rc.rhyme.incorrect: That one ends another way. Listen again.
en.rc.rhyme.hint.model: Listen to how each one ends.
en.rc.beats.instruction: Clap the word. How many claps?
en.rc.beats.incorrect: Not that many. Listen to the claps.
en.rc.spell.incorrect: Not quite. Listen to it slowly.
en.rc.pairs.meet: Two letters, one sound. This word starts with it.
en.rc.pairs.picture.instruction: Which one starts with this sound?
en.rc.pairs.letter.instruction: Which letters does it start with?
en.rc.pairs.letter.correct: Yes. It starts with those letters.
en.rc.sentence.instruction: Read it. Which picture is it?
en.rc.sentence.correct: Yes. That is what it says.
en.rc.sentence.incorrect: It says something else. Read it again.
en.rc.sentence.hint.model: Here it is, word by word.

skills.title: Tell sounds apart
skills.objective: Hears a sound and finds what made it, out of two or three things that make different sounds.

skills.title: Repeat a pattern of sounds
skills.objective: Hears two or three sounds one after another and plays them back in the same order.

skills.title: Hear the first sound of a word: s, m, f
skills.objective: Hears that two spoken words start with the same sound, for words that start with s, m or f. Done by ear, with pictures; no letters are shown.

skills.title: Hear the first sound of a word: n, l, r
skills.objective: Hears that two spoken words start with the same sound, for words that start with n, l or r.

skills.title: Link letters to their sounds: s, m, a, t
skills.objective: Shown the letter s or m or a or t with no word to help, finds a picture whose word starts with its sound; and shown a picture, finds the letter its word starts with.

skills.title: Link letters to their sounds: p, i, n, o
skills.objective: Shown the letter p or i or n or o with no word to help, finds a picture whose word starts with its sound; and shown a picture, finds the letter its word starts with.

skills.title: Link letters to their sounds: f, l, c, h
skills.objective: Shown the letter f or l or c or h with no word to help, finds a picture whose word starts with its sound; and shown a picture, finds the letter its word starts with.

skills.title: Link letters to their sounds: u, e, r
skills.objective: Shown the letter u or e or r with no word to help, finds a picture whose word starts with its sound; and shown a picture, finds the letter its word starts with.

skills.title: Blend a slow word by ear
skills.objective: Hears a short word said slowly, sound running into sound, and knows which word it is, told apart from a word one sound different.

skills.title: Read a short word
skills.objective: Reads a three-letter word made of letters already taught, with nothing said aloud, and finds its picture among words that are nearly the same.

skills.title: Hear that two words rhyme
skills.objective: Hears a word and finds the one that rhymes with it, told apart from a word that starts the same and a word that only ends with the same sound. Done by ear, with pictures.

skills.title: Clap the beats of a word
skills.objective: Hears a word of one, two or three beats said plainly, and says how many beats it has by choosing as many claps.

skills.title: Build a short word from its sounds
skills.objective: Hears a three-sound word said plainly and puts its three letters in order: the first sound, the middle one, the last.

skills.title: Link two letters to one sound: sh, ch, th
skills.objective: Shown sh or ch or th with no word to help, finds a picture whose word starts with its sound, and shown a picture, finds the pair its word starts with, told apart from the single letters.

skills.title: Read a short word with sh, ch or th
skills.objective: Reads a word of three sounds, one of them written with two letters, with nothing said aloud, and finds its picture among words that are nearly the same.

skills.title: Read a short sentence
skills.objective: Reads five short words in a row with nothing said aloud, and finds the picture they tell of among pictures that differ by one word.

lessons.title: What made that sound?
lessons.summary: A sound is played and your child finds the thing that makes it: a drum, a bell, a shaker, a whistle, a bird, a clock. Listening closely to sounds comes before listening for the sounds inside words.

lessons.title: Play it back
lessons.summary: Two or three sounds are played, one after another, and your child plays them back in the same order. Holding a short string of sounds in mind is what blending sounds into words will ask for later.

lessons.title: Which one rhymes?
lessons.summary: Your child hears a word and finds the picture whose word rhymes with it: cat, hat. Beside it is a word that starts the same, which is the one children pick before they have the idea of rhyme. All by ear: no letters are shown.

lessons.title: Clap the word
lessons.summary: A word is said and clapped in its beats: el, e, phant is three claps. Your child finds the card with as many claps. On their own the word is only said, and the clapping is theirs to do. Clapping the beats of a word comes before hearing the sounds inside one.

lessons.title: Which one starts the same? (s, m, f)
lessons.summary: Your child hears a word and finds the picture whose word starts with the same sound. The first sound is drawn out so that it can be heard: sss, mmm and fff. No letters yet: this is all by ear.

lessons.title: Which one starts the same? (n, l, r)
lessons.summary: Your child hears a word and finds the picture whose word starts with the same sound. The first sound is drawn out so that it can be heard: nnn, lll and rrr. No letters yet: this is all by ear.

lessons.title: Letters and their sounds: s, m, a, t
lessons.summary: Your child meets the letters s, m, a, t, each with a word that begins with its sound, then finds the picture that starts with a letter's sound, and the letter a picture starts with. On their own, the letter is shown without a word to help.

lessons.title: Letters and their sounds: p, i, n, o
lessons.summary: Your child meets the letters p, i, n, o, each with a word that begins with its sound, then finds the picture that starts with a letter's sound, and the letter a picture starts with. On their own, the letter is shown without a word to help.

lessons.title: Letters and their sounds: f, l, c, h
lessons.summary: Your child meets the letters f, l, c, h, each with a word that begins with its sound, then finds the picture that starts with a letter's sound, and the letter a picture starts with. On their own, the letter is shown without a word to help.

lessons.title: Letters and their sounds: u, e, r
lessons.summary: Your child meets the letters u, e, r, each with a word that begins with its sound, then finds the picture that starts with a letter's sound, and the letter a picture starts with. On their own, the letter is shown without a word to help.

lessons.title: The slow word
lessons.summary: A word is said slowly, its sounds running into one another, and your child finds its picture. Next to it is a picture whose word is one sound different. This is blending by ear: no letters are shown.

lessons.title: Read the word
lessons.summary: A short word is shown in letters your child has met. With help it is said slowly as a finger runs under it. On their own nothing is said: your child reads the word and finds its picture among words that are nearly the same, so the picture cannot be chosen without reading.

lessons.title: Build the word
lessons.summary: A word is said, and its three letters lie out of order. Your child puts each in its place: first sound, middle, last. With help the word is said slowly and each place lights as its sound comes. This is pulling a word apart into its sounds, the other half of blending.

lessons.title: Two letters, one sound: sh, ch, th
lessons.summary: Your child meets sh, ch, th: two letters that together write one sound, each with a word that begins with it. Then the picture that starts with a pair's sound, and the pair a picture starts with, told apart from s, c, t and h on their own.

lessons.title: Read the word: sh, ch, th
lessons.summary: A short word with sh, ch or th in it is shown in letters, the two letters together on one tile because they write one sound. On their own nothing is said: your child reads the word and finds its picture among words that are nearly the same.

lessons.title: Read the sentence
lessons.summary: Five short words in a row: a cat on a mat. Your child reads them and finds the picture they tell of, beside pictures that are one word different, so every word has to be read. With help the sentence is read aloud, a finger under each word; on their own nothing is said.
